arabic text:
WOO SHAM KAY MANZAR KAYSAY THAY, KYON KHOON RAWAA'N HAY
ANKHON SAY
KAYSA THA QAYAMAT KA MANZAR, JAB LAUT KAY ABID GHAR POHNCHAY
POOCHA THA MADINAY WALON NAY, KYON KHOON RAWAA'N HAY ANKHON
SAY
english translation text:
What were those scenes of Shaam, and why
does blood flow from your eyes? What a
scene of Judgement Day it was when Abid
returned home. The people of Madina asked him:
why does blood flow from your eyes?

arabic text: BAY GOOR O KAFAN LASHA APNAY, BABA KA MAIN NAY DEKHA HAY\nLILLAH NA POOCHU YE MUJH SAY, KYON KHOON RAWAA'N HAY ANKHON SAY
english translation text: I saw my father's body lying without grave or shroud.\nFor God's sake, do not ask me why blood flows from my eyes.

arabic text: HAR SIMAT SAY PATTHAR AATAY THAY, AUR AAG LAYEE'N BARSATAY THAY\nBATLAWON BHALA TUM KO KAYSAY, KYON KHOON RAWAA'N HAY ANKHON\nSAY
english translation text: Stones came from every direction, and the accursed\nones rained fire. How can I possibly tell\nyou why blood flows from my eyes?

arabic text: AADA NAY NOOK E NAYZA SAY, TATHEER KE CHADAR CHEENI HAY\nBHOLAY SAY BHI AB KOI NA KAHAY, KYON KHOON RAWAA'N HAY ANKHON SAY
english translation text: The enemies used spear-points to snatch the chadar of purification.\nLet no one ever again ask why blood flows from my eyes.

arabic text: BAZAR KE HALAT KAYSAY KAHON, DARBAR MAIN KAYSAY POHNCHAY THAY\nHUM SAY NA KOI AB YE POOCHAY, KYON KHOON RAWAA'N HAY ANKHON SAY
english translation text: How can I describe the marketplace, or how we entered the court?\nLet no one now ask us why blood flows from our eyes.

arabic text: DU LAAL THAY AIK MAA KAY DONO, QISMAT NAY USS SAY CHEEN LIYE\nUSS MAA SAY KOI KAYSAY YE KAHAY, KYON KHOON RAWAA'NHAY ANKHON\nSAY
english translation text: A mother had two sons, and destiny took\nboth away from her. How can anyone ask\nthat mother why blood flows from her eyes?

arabic text: ASHHAR SAJJAD KAY PAYRON KAY, CHALOON SAY KHOON NIKALTA THA\nCHALAY BHI RO KAR KEHTAY THAY, KYON KHOON RAWAA'N HAY ANKHON SAY
english translation text: O Ashhar, blood flowed from the blisters upon Sajjad's feet;\neven as he walked, he wept and said: why does blood flow from my eyes?
